channel.title: GamerPower Giveaways
channel.description: Find, Track and collect the best giveaways in gaming!

item.title: Vaultbreakers Starter Pack Key Giveaway
item.description: Claim your free Vaultbreakers Starter Pack Key and unlock several in-game items for Vaultbreakers including 2000 Gold, 100 Legacy, Healing Potions and more!

item.title: Meltdown Playtest Steam Key Giveaway
item.description: Claim free Steam keys for Meltdown (playtest)! The playtest will run from Oct 9 - 16.

item.title: Fireside Feelings (Steam) Giveaway
item.description: Grab a blanket and join this Steam giveaway! Fireside Feelings is free on Steam until October 12! Fireside Feelings is a cozy 2d game about social interactions and connections! Don´t miss it!

item.title: Pony Island (Steam) Giveaway
item.description: Yes, this is real! You can grab Pony Island for free on Steam! Pony Island is a suspenseful puzzle game disguised as something much more interesting. Definitely worth checking out

item.title: The Big Con (Mobile) Giveaway
item.description:
The Big Con (Mobile version) is free until October 15 on the Epic Games Store App for iPhone, iPad, and Android.
Note: May not be available in all regions

item.title: TerraScape (Epic Games) Giveaway
item.description: Win some relaxation with this giveaway! Score TerraScape for free via Epic Games Store! TerraScape is a fun 3d cozy city builder with relaxing puzzles and randomly generated maps. Don´t miss it!

item.title: Out of Sight (Epic Games) Giveaway
item.description: Explore a dark and mysterious mansion! Download Out of Sight for free via the Epic Games Store and dive into this unique second-person atmospheric adventure game.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack Steam Giveaway
item.description: Score Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack (DLC) for free via Steam until until October 22. Please note the base game is required to enjoy this DLC content.

item.title: Spooky Cats Steam Key Giveaway
item.description: Fanatical is giving away Spooky Cats Steam keys for free! Grab your Steam key before it's too late!

item.title: Everwind AW-51 Pack Steam Key Giveaway
item.description: Claim your free Everwind AW-51 Pack Steam Key! Please note that this DLC giveaway requires the base game and 10 ARP (Arena Reward Points) to claim a key. Fortunately, you can earn ARP for free every day simply by logging into the website.

item.title: Scallywags Playtest Steam Key Giveaway
item.description: Claim your free Scallywags Playtest Steam Key and join the early access!

item.title: Bounty Train (GOG) Giveaway
item.description: Conquer the Wild West on rails! GOG is giving away Bounty Train for free! Bounty Train is a 2d simulation game about assembling, managing, and controlling locomotives.

item.title: Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack (Steam) Giveaway
item.description: Score Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack (DLC) for free via Steam! Each pack unlocks new playable species, new weapon powers and much more! Please note the base game is required to enjoy this DLC content.
